group.name: apsystems_ecu_control
group.label: APsystems ECU control
group.desc: Vendor model emitted by ecu-sunspec on unit ID 1. ECU Service Mode (fast polling) control and freshness of the ECU's last radio cycle.

points.name: FastPoll
points.label: Service Mode
points.desc: ECU Service Mode (/etc/yuneng/fast_polling.conf) polls the inverters every ~20 s instead of every 5 min and stops the inverter production data sent to EMA (EMA loses that energy). 0 normal; 1 Service Mode, kept on by the adapter (main.exe drops it after 60 minutes); 2 automatic: Service Mode while production is at or above FastPollThresholdW, normal mode below. FastPollElapsedS > 0 tells whether Service Mode is on right now.

points.name: FastPollElapsedS
points.label: Service Mode Elapsed
points.desc: Seconds since Service Mode was entered (saturates at 65534); 0 in normal mode.

points.name: LastPollTms
points.label: Last Poll Time
points.desc: Unix time of the ECU's last radio cycle (mtime of /tmp/parameters_app.conf).

points.name: DataAgeS
points.label: Data Age
points.desc: Seconds since the ECU's last radio cycle.

points.name: LastProdRecTms
points.label: Last Production Record
points.desc: Unix time of the newest inverter production record (APS18) queued for EMA in /home/record.db.

points.name: ProdRecPending
points.label: Production Records Pending
points.desc: Production records not yet marked sent (normally 0 or 1).

points.name: ProdRecLastHour
points.label: Production Records Last Hour
points.desc: Production records dated within the last hour: 12 in normal mode, 0 while Service Mode is on.

points.name: LastEmaCtrlTms
points.label: Last EMA Control Contact
points.desc: Unix time of control_client's last successful EMA session (every 15 min), from /home/control_client.log.

points.name: ProdRecAgeS
points.label: Production Record Age
points.desc: Seconds since the newest production record.

points.name: FastPollThresholdW
points.label: Service Mode Threshold
points.desc: Automatic mode (FastPoll = 2): Service Mode while system production is at or above this power, normal mode once it has stayed below threshold - max(10 W, 20 %) for 2 minutes; at most one switch every 10 minutes. Default 50 W.
